title: Stairway to Heaven Cottage - Vacation Rental in Rosemary Beach,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents... "Stairway to Heaven Cottage," a luxurious Gulfside retreat in Rosemary Beach. This five-bedroom haven is just steps from the beach (2-min walk), tennis courts, and the famous Coquina Community Pool. With a spacious shared courtyard, 3 King En-suites, sleeping porch, and kid-friendly bunk rooms, it’s the perfect choice for families or groups of up to 11. Learn more below… 👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Steps to Coquina Pool (1 Min Walk), Beach (2 Mins), and Tennis Courts (3 Mins)3 Spacious King Suites Plus Kid-Friendly Bunk RoomsSleeping Porch with Quiet Ambiance for Evening RelaxationOpen-Concept Kitchen with High-End Stainless Steel AppliancesLarge Living Spaces with Stylish Furnishings and Natural LightShared Courtyard Perfect for Outdoor Gatherings7 Adult Beach Bikes Included for Exploring 30A!Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "Great house, great location! Loved the proximity to the beach, pool, and playground." – Lauren A.⭐"Perfect location & accommodations for our stay! Would highly recommend this property." – Michael K.⭐"Beautiful house in a prime location. Kids loved the 3rd floor and we all enjoyed the porches!" – Natalie S.*** LIVING AREAS ***Bright and inviting, the first-floor living area is designed for relaxation and connection. With oversized windows filling the room with natural light, you’ll feel at ease lounging on the plush sofa while enjoying a favorite movie or TV series on the large flat-screen.Stylish Decor with Ample Natural LightComfortable Sofa and Lounge ChairsLarge Flat-Screen TV*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The gourmet kitchen is every chef's dream! It features high-end stainless steel appliances, a gas range, and plenty of counter space for meal prep. Adjacent, the dining area provides a cozy and stylish spot for family meals or celebratory dinners.High-End Stainless Steel Appliances & Gas RangeLarge Island with Breakfast Bar Seating for 4Dining Table for 8 Perfect for Group Meals*** OUTDOOR OASIS ***Spend your evenings sipping a glass of wine in the spacious shared courtyard or relaxing on the front porch with a swing. Whether it’s a casual family BBQ or a quiet moment in the evening breeze, this outdoor space has you covered.Shared Courtyard with Cornhole GameFront Porch with a Swing7 Bikes Provided for Exploring the Scenic 30A Area*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***This home's layout is perfect for families with children, offering ample space and a variety of sleeping arrangements to suit everyone’s needs. With luxurious suites for adults and fun, kid-friendly bunk rooms, it’s designed to accommodate both comfort and convenience.1st Floor:Half Bathroom: Conveniently located for guests2nd Floor:Primary Suite: King Bed, Private Access to the Sleeping Porch, En-Suite with Walk-In Shower, and Deep-Soaking TubCalifornia King Suite: Spacious Room with En-Suite BathroomKing Suite: Modern Room with Private En-Suite3rd Floor:Bunk Room 1: Twin over Twin Beds, Bright and Fun for Kids!Bunk Room 2: Twin over Queen Bunk, Perfect for Families*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Nestled in the heart of Rosemary Beach, this home places you at the center of paradise. Enjoy sugar-white sands and emerald waters just a 2-minute walk away, or explore 30A’s best dining and shopping on nearby Main Street.Coquina Pool (1-Min Walk)Beach Access with Restrooms (2-Min Walk)Award-Winning Tennis Courts and Pro Shop (3-Min Walk)Rosemary Beach Town Center, Heated Sky Pool and Fitness Center (4-minute walk)Racquet Club – One of the World’s Top 75 Tennis SpotsRosemary Beach Community: Beachside Destination with Award-Winning ArchitectureMultiple Parks & Greens: Playgrounds, Splash Pad, Butterfly Park, Boardwalks, and Fountains4 RESORT POOLSBarbados Pool: Gulf-side, French West Indies style with a fountainCoquina Pool: Gulf-side, with a relaxing negative edge overflowSky Pool: Park-side, indoor, heated year-round with radiant heated decking in winterCabana Pool: Park-side, cabana-style with a children’s pool & playground nearby*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 7 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 4526STRO #: STR-004526
